brand_identity.name: Битва экстрасенсов — официальный сайт помощи
brand_identity.mission: Provide a safe, official channel for people to seek spiritual help.

typography.import_instructions: Import fonts from Google Fonts in index.css: @import url('https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Cormorant+Garamond:wght@300;400;500;600;700&family=Manrope:wght@300;400;500;600;700&display=swap');

layout_strategies.bento_grid: Use strictly for Participants section. Grid cols 1 (mobile) -> 3 (desktop). Spans should vary for 'Top Rated' psychics.
layout_strategies.hero_section: Full screen height (min-h-screen). Center alignment for gravity. Text must have 'text-shadow' for readability over dark images.

buttons.primary: bg-[#6b1525] hover:bg-[#8a1c30] text-white rounded-sm px-8 py-6 text-lg uppercase tracking-widest transition-all duration-300 shadow-[0_0_10px_rgba(107,21,37,0.5)] hover:shadow-[0_0_20px_rgba(107,21,37,0.8)]
buttons.secondary: bg-transparent border border-[#d4af37] text-[#d4af37] hover:bg-[#d4af37] hover:text-black rounded-sm px-8 py-6 text-lg uppercase tracking-widest transition-all duration-300

cards.participant_card: relative overflow-hidden group border border-white/5 bg-[#0a0a0a] hover:border-[#d4af37]/50 transition-colors duration-500
cards.feature_card: p-8 border border-white/5 bg-gradient-to-br from-white/5 to-transparent hover:from-[#6b1525]/20 transition-all duration-500

inputs.style: bg-black/50 border-white/10 focus:border-[#d4af37] focus:ring-1 focus:ring-[#d4af37] text-white placeholder:text-white/30 h-14

styles.fade_up: initial={{ opacity: 0, y: 20 }} animate={{ opacity: 1, y: 0 }} transition={{ duration: 0.6 }}
styles.slow_zoom: initial={{ scale: 1 }} animate={{ scale: 1.05 }} transition={{ duration: 10, repeat: Infinity, repeatType: 'reverse' }}

accessibility.contrast_check: Ensure gold text (#d4af37) is only used on very dark backgrounds. On lighter backgrounds, use a darker gold/bronze.
accessibility.focus_states: Focus rings must be visible. Use gold (#d4af37) ring with offset.

universal_guidelines: Do not use gradients for text.
Do not use rounded-xl or rounded-2xl. This brand is sharp, serious, and mystical. Use rounded-none or rounded-sm.
Use 'Cormorant Garamond' for all headings. Use 'Manrope' for all body text.
Always add a subtle noise texture overlay to the entire body if possible (opacity 0.03) to reduce digital flatness.
Forms must feel 'official' but elegant. No cartoony inputs.
